rationale: Plan addresses all task questions: claim counts and status splits via claim_volume with status breakdown; denial rate via denial_rate using adjudicated_claims denominator to exclude pending claims and correctly measure the rate; fraud prevalence via fraud_prevalence; financial summary (billed, allowed, paid totals and per-claim statistics) via financial_summary; monthly volume trend via monthly_trend on service_date_from to align with when care began rather than processing date. All standard artifacts produced: status distribution chart, monthly trend chart and table, financial summary table, report. Report configured to show denominators for clarity and cite artifacts for traceability.
changes_summary: Fixed two critical issues: (1) Changed denial_rate denominator from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude pending claims not yet decided, yielding the correct denial rate of 1286/12339 = 0.1042 instead of 0.1001. (2) Changed monthly_trend date_column from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to align trends with when care actually occurred rather than when claims were processed, avoiding lag-induced inconsistencies.
